# MAYOR — verified free references (12 October 2026)

| Resource | Address | Licence / Use | How to use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kenney City Kit Roads | https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads | **CC0**, original download has 90 files; game/commercial allowed | Import signs, road props, sidewalks, reference road components |
| Poly Haven | https://polyhaven.com/license | **CC0 assets** | Asphalt/concrete/road-surface PBR maps (API terms separately apply) |
| Asphalt material | https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02 | **CC0** | Albedo/normal/roughness textures |
| Pavement material | https://polyhaven.com/a/pavement_05 | **CC0** | Sidewalk textures |
| ambientCG | https://ambientcg.com | **CC0 assets** | Alternative PBR material library |
| Blender MCP | https://github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender | **MIT** addon | Run scripts inside *your* Blender from Claude/Codex; executable local Python requires trust |
| Road Builder for C:S II | https://github.com/JadHajjar/RoadBuilder-CSII | **source reference, check repository licence before copying any code** | Study lane composition and road presets, never extract proprietary C:S II assets |
| Three Roads | https://github.com/vibe-stack/three-roads | **MIT** | Most promising Three.js network/mesher reference for MAYOR runtime. Check API/road-network assumptions |
| MRoadGen | https://github.com/MaartenNauta-Pathtrace/MRoadGen | **CC0** (repo README/LICENSE) | Blender geometry node roads and embankment approach; check code availability (repo limited) |
| BlenderScenarioGenerator | https://github.com/AugmentedDesignLab/BlenderScenarioGenerator | **MIT** | OpenDRIVE and Python road authoring ideas |
| three.path | https://github.com/shawn0326/three.path | **MIT** | Three.js spline mesh examples |
| realistic-road-works | https://github.com/jasperaelvoet/realistic-road-works | **MIT source**; in-game models are C:S II proprietary | Construction staging concept only; do not redistribute game meshes/textures |

**Legal rule:** a public mod repository is not a licence for the commercial game's meshes, road textures, assets, UI art or maps. Copy only third-party code/assets whose standalone licence allows your use. Observe MIT copyright notices; CC0 content needs no attribution but recording source is helpful.

**No third-party assets are included** in MAYOR Road Kit. Original meshes are generated locally by the supplied script.
